description: This file defines the IEventHubDataAdapter interface for integrating Azure Event Hubs with Orleans streaming, including methods for message conversion, stream position retrieval, and stream identity management.

classes.name: IEventHubDataAdapter
classes.description: Interface for adapting Event Hub messages to Orleans stream messages, providing methods for message conversion, position retrieval, and stream identity.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts an EventData message from the queue into a CachedMessage, given the stream position, dequeue time, and a function to get message segments.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the stream position for a given partition and EventData message.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Extracts the offset string from a CachedMessage.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the partition key associated with a given stream ID.

methods.name: GetStreamIdentity
methods.description: Gets the StreamId representing the identity of the stream from an EventData message.
